```{r}
# ============================================================
# Reload Migratory and Resident AKDE Inputs and Outputs
# Add AKDE low, est, and high estimates to the input CSVs
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

input_base_path <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

# Original cleaned input datasets used for AKDE
migratory_input_path <- file.path(
  input_base_path,
  "combined_migratory_ids_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv"
)

resident_input_path <- file.path(
  input_base_path,
  "combined_resident_ids_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv"
)

# Migratory AKDE output location
migratory_akde_dir <- file.path(
  input_base_path,
  "akde_outputs"
)

migratory_area_path <- file.path(
  migratory_akde_dir,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)

# Resident AKDE output location on the SanDisk drive
resident_akde_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

resident_area_path <- file.path(
  resident_akde_dir,
  "resident_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)

# New output files
migratory_joined_out <- file.path(
  migratory_akde_dir,
  "migratory_input_with_AKDE_area.csv"
)

resident_joined_out <- file.path(
  resident_akde_dir,
  "resident_input_with_AKDE_area.csv"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Verify that all required files exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_files <- c(
  migratory_input_path,
  resident_input_path,
  migratory_area_path,
  resident_area_path
)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required files were not foun<LOCAL_PATH>",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

cat("All required files were found.\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helper: parse timestamps consistently
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Helper: create one consistent date_time column
# ------------------------------------------------------------

standardize_datetime <- function(df) {
  
  if ("date_time" %in% names(df)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date_time))
    
  } else if ("date" %in% names(df)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date))
    
  } else {
    
    stop("Neither a date_time nor date column was found.")
  }
  
  df
}

# ============================================================
# MIGRATORY DATA
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Reload migratory input and AKDE area output
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_input <- read_csv(
  migratory_input_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  standardize_datetime()

migratory_area <- read_csv(
  migratory_area_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = parse_datetime_safe(window_start)
  )

cat("\nMigratory input rows:", nrow(migratory_input), "\n")
cat("Migratory AKDE rows:", nrow(migratory_area), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Recreate id_phase exactly as in the AKDE pipeline
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"phases" %in% names(migratory_input)) {
  stop("The migratory input does not contain a phases column.")
}

migratory_input <- migratory_input %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    
    phases_clean = phases %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_lower(),
    
    phase_num = str_extract(phases_clean, "\\d+"),
    
    phase_label = case_when(
      !is.na(phase_num) ~ paste0("Phase_", phase_num),
      TRUE ~ phases_clean %>%
        str_to_title() %>%
        str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
    ),
    
    id_phase = paste(id, phase_label, sep = "_")
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Prepare migratory AKDE output for joining
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_area_join <- migratory_area %>%
  mutate(
    id_phase = as.character(id_phase)
  ) %>%
  select(
    id_phase,
    window_start,
    akde_low = low,
    akde_est = est,
    akde_high = high
  )

# Check for duplicate join keys
migratory_duplicate_windows <- migratory_area_join %>%
  count(id_phase, window_start, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(migratory_duplicate_windows) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Duplicate migratory ID_Phase/window_start combinations were found. ",
    "They will be collapsed before joining."
  )
  
  migratory_area_join <- migratory_area_join %>%
    group_by(id_phase, window_start) %>%
    summarise(
      akde_low = first(akde_low),
      akde_est = first(akde_est),
      akde_high = first(akde_high),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Join migratory AKDE area estimates to input data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_with_akde <- migratory_input %>%
  left_join(
    migratory_area_join,
    by = c(
      "id_phase",
      "date_time" = "window_start"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, phase_num, date_time)

cat("\nMigratory rows after join:", nrow(migratory_with_akde), "\n")
cat(
  "Migratory rows with AKDE estimates:",
  sum(!is.na(migratory_with_akde$akde_est)),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Migratory rows without AKDE estimates:",
  sum(is.na(migratory_with_akde$akde_est)),
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Migratory join summary by ID and phase
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_join_summary <- migratory_with_akde %>%
  group_by(id, phase_label, id_phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n_input_rows = n(),
    n_akde_windows = sum(!is.na(akde_est)),
    first_date = min(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, phase_label)

cat("\nMigratory AKDE join summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(migratory_join_summary, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# RESIDENT DATA
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Reload resident input and AKDE area output
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_input <- read_csv(
  resident_input_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  standardize_datetime() %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id))

resident_area <- read_csv(
  resident_area_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    window_start = parse_datetime_safe(window_start)
  )

cat("\nResident input rows:", nrow(resident_input), "\n")
cat("Resident AKDE rows:", nrow(resident_area), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Prepare resident AKDE output for joining
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_area_join <- resident_area %>%
  select(
    id,
    window_start,
    akde_low = low,
    akde_est = est,
    akde_high = high
  )

# Check for duplicate join keys
resident_duplicate_windows <- resident_area_join %>%
  count(id, window_start, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(resident_duplicate_windows) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Duplicate resident ID/window_start combinations were found. ",
    "They will be collapsed before joining."
  )
  
  resident_area_join <- resident_area_join %>%
    group_by(id, window_start) %>%
    summarise(
      akde_low = first(akde_low),
      akde_est = first(akde_est),
      akde_high = first(akde_high),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Join resident AKDE area estimates to input data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_with_akde <- resident_input %>%
  left_join(
    resident_area_join,
    by = c(
      "id",
      "date_time" = "window_start"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, date_time)

cat("\nResident rows after join:", nrow(resident_with_akde), "\n")
cat(
  "Resident rows with AKDE estimates:",
  sum(!is.na(resident_with_akde$akde_est)),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Resident rows without AKDE estimates:",
  sum(is.na(resident_with_akde$akde_est)),
  "\n"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Resident join summary by ID
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resident_join_summary <- resident_with_akde %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_input_rows = n(),
    n_akde_windows = sum(!is.na(akde_est)),
    first_date = min(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(id)

cat("\nResident AKDE join summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(resident_join_summary, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# SAVE AUGMENTED DATASETS
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Remove temporary phase-cleaning columns if desired
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_export <- migratory_with_akde %>%
  select(
    -phases_clean,
    -phase_num
  )

resident_export <- resident_with_akde

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save augmented input datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  migratory_export,
  migratory_joined_out
)

write_csv(
  resident_export,
  resident_joined_out
)

# Save join summaries too
write_csv(
  migratory_join_summary,
  file.path(
    migratory_akde_dir,
    "migratory_AKDE_join_summary.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  resident_join_summary,
  file.path(
    resident_akde_dir,
    "resident_AKDE_join_summary.csv"
  )
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Finished joining AKDE estimates.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("\nMigratory augmented CSV saved t<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(migratory_joined_out, "\n")

cat("\nResident augmented CSV saved t<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(resident_joined_out, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Combine Migratory and Resident Datasets with AKDE Areas
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------


# Resident AKDE output location
resident_akde_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


migratory_path <- file.path(
  resident_akde_dir,
  "migratory_input_with_AKDE_area.csv"
)


# Resident AKDE output location
resident_akde_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

resident_path <- file.path(
  resident_akde_dir,
  "resident_input_with_AKDE_area.csv"
)

# Final combined output
combined_out_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

combined_out_path <- file.path(
  combined_out_dir,
  "combined_migratory_resident_with_AKDE_area.csv"
)

dir.create(
  combined_out_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Check that both input files exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(migratory_path)) {
  stop("Migratory AKDE dataset not foun<LOCAL_PATH>", migratory_path)
}

if (!file.exists(resident_path)) {
  stop("Resident AKDE dataset not foun<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_path)
}

cat("Migratory file foun<LOCAL_PATH>", migratory_path, "\n\n")
cat("Resident file foun<LOCAL_PATH>", resident_path, "\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Reload datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_data_akde <- read_csv(
  migratory_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()

resident_data_akde <- read_csv(
  resident_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()

cat("Migratory rows:", nrow(migratory_data_akde), "\n")
cat("Resident rows :", nrow(resident_data_akde), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Standardize datetime columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
}

standardize_datetime <- function(df) {
  
  if ("date_time" %in% names(df)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date_time))
    
  } else if ("date" %in% names(df)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(date_time = parse_datetime_safe(date))
    
  } else {
    
    stop("No date or date_time column found.")
  }
  
  df
}

migratory_data_akde <- migratory_data_akde %>%
  standardize_datetime()

resident_data_akde <- resident_data_akde %>%
  standardize_datetime()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Standardize dataset labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_data_akde <- migratory_data_akde %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    dataset = "Migratory"
  )

resident_data_akde <- resident_data_akde %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    dataset = "Resident"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Ensure AKDE columns exist in both datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

akde_cols <- c(
  "akde_low",
  "akde_est",
  "akde_high"
)

missing_migratory_akde <- setdiff(
  akde_cols,
  names(migratory_data_akde)
)

missing_resident_akde <- setdiff(
  akde_cols,
  names(resident_data_akde)
)

if (length(missing_migratory_akde) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Migratory data is missing AKDE columns: ",
    paste(missing_migratory_akde, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(missing_resident_akde) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Resident data is missing AKDE columns: ",
    paste(missing_resident_akde, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Check column differences before combining
# ------------------------------------------------------------

migratory_only_columns <- setdiff(
  names(migratory_data_akde),
  names(resident_data_akde)
)

resident_only_columns <- setdiff(
  names(resident_data_akde),
  names(migratory_data_akde)
)

cat("\nColumns only in migratory datase<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(migratory_only_columns)

cat("\nColumns only in resident datase<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(resident_only_columns)

# bind_rows will automatically fill unavailable columns with NA
# For example, id_phase may exist only for migratory rows.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Combine datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_deer_akde <- bind_rows(
  migratory_data_akde,
  resident_data_akde
) %>%
  arrange(dataset, id, date_time)

cat("\nCombined rows:", nrow(combined_deer_akde), "\n")
cat("Combined columns:", ncol(combined_deer_akde), "\n")
cat("Unique IDs:", n_distinct(combined_deer_akde$id), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Validation checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_summary <- combined_deer_akde %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),
    min_date = min(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_date = max(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rows_with_akde = sum(!is.na(akde_est)),
    n_rows_without_akde = sum(is.na(akde_est)),
    mean_akde_est = mean(akde_est, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_akde_est = median(akde_est, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nCombined dataset summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(combined_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Check for duplicated rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------

duplicate_check <- combined_deer_akde %>%
  count(dataset, id, date_time, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat("\nDuplicated dataset-ID-time combinations:", nrow(duplicate_check), "\n")

if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  print(duplicate_check, n = Inf)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Check AKDE availability by ID
# ------------------------------------------------------------

akde_by_id <- combined_deer_akde %>%
  group_by(dataset, id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_akde_rows = sum(!is.na(akde_est)),
    pct_rows_with_akde = round(
      100 * n_akde_rows / n_rows,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, id)

cat("\nAKDE coverage by I<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(akde_by_id, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Save combined dataset and summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  combined_deer_akde,
  combined_out_path
)

write_csv(
  combined_summary,
  file.path(
    combined_out_dir,
    "combined_migratory_resident_AKDE_summary.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  akde_by_id,
  file.path(
    combined_out_dir,
    "combined_migratory_resident_AKDE_coverage_by_id.csv"
  )
)

if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    duplicate_check,
    file.path(
      combined_out_dir,
      "combined_migratory_resident_duplicate_check.csv"
    )
  )
}

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Combined dataset saved successfully.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("\nFinal combined CS<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(combined_out_path, "\n")

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# ============================================================
# 1) Read combined dataset
# ============================================================

combined_data <- read_csv(
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),

    date_time = parse_date_time(
      date_time,
      orders = c(
        "Y-m-d H:M:S",
        "Y-m-d HMS",
        "Y-m-d HM",
        "Y-m-d",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 2) True migratory IDs
# ============================================================

true_migratory_ids <- c(
  "F94", "F91", "F87", "F74", "F47", "F30", "F26", "F103",
  "A61", "A60", "A58", "A57", "A56", "A49", "A48", "A44", "A29"
)

updated_migratory_data_4 <- combined_data %>%
  filter(id %in% true_migratory_ids)

cat(
  "\nNumber of migratory IDs used:",
  n_distinct(updated_migratory_data_4$id),
  "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 3) Extract phase number
#
# Odd phases  = resident
# Even phases = migratory
# ============================================================

migratory_split <- updated_migratory_data_4 %>%
  mutate(
    phase_text = str_to_lower(
      str_trim(as.character(phases))
    ),

    phase_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(
        as.character(phases),
        "\\d+"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    phase_text != "remove",
    !is.na(phase_number),
    !is.na(date_time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_type = case_when(
      phase_number %% 2 == 1 ~ "resident_range",
      phase_number %% 2 == 0 ~ "migratory_range",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("\nRecords by phas<LOCAL_PATH>")

print(
  migratory_split %>%
    count(
      phase_number,
      range_type,
      name = "n_records"
    ) %>%
    arrange(phase_number)
)

# ============================================================
# 4) Find the start and end of every phase for every deer
# ============================================================

phase_dates_by_id <- migratory_split %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    phase_number,
    range_type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    phase_start = min(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    phase_end   = max(date_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_records   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_midpoint = phase_start +
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          phase_end,
          phase_start,
          units = "secs"
        )
      ) / 2
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, phase_start)

cat("\nIndividual phase date<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(phase_dates_by_id, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 5) Keep only migratory phases
# ============================================================

individual_migrations <- phase_dates_by_id %>%
  filter(range_type == "migratory_range") %>%
  arrange(id, phase_midpoint) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    number_of_migrations = n(),
    migration_order = row_number(),

    # For deer with two migration phases:
    # earliest migration = spring
    # latest migration   = fall
    #
    # For deer with only one migration phase:
    # classify according to the midpoint month.
    migration_season = case_when(
      number_of_migrations >= 2 &
        migration_order == 1 ~ "spring",

      number_of_migrations >= 2 &
        migration_order == number_of_migrations ~ "fall",

      number_of_migrations == 1 &
        month(phase_midpoint) %in% 1:7 ~ "spring",

      number_of_migrations == 1 &
        month(phase_midpoint) %in% 8:12 ~ "fall",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(migration_season))

cat("\nIndividual migration classification<LOCAL_PATH>")

print(
  individual_migrations %>%
    select(
      id,
      phase_number,
      phase_start,
      phase_end,
      phase_midpoint,
      migration_season
    ),
  n = Inf
)

# ============================================================
# 6) Check how phases were classified
# ============================================================

cat("\nPhase classification count<LOCAL_PATH>")

print(
  individual_migrations %>%
    count(
      phase_number,
      migration_season,
      name = "n_deer"
    ) %>%
    arrange(migration_season, phase_number)
)

# ============================================================
# 7) Standardize dates to the reference year 2000
#
# This removes the actual year while preserving month and day.
# Year 2000 is used because it has 366 days.
# ============================================================

individual_migrations_std <- individual_migrations %>%
  mutate(
    migration_start_std = make_date(
      year = 2000,
      month = month(phase_start),
      day = day(phase_start)
    ),

    migration_end_std = make_date(
      year = 2000,
      month = month(phase_end),
      day = day(phase_end)
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 8) Calculate herd-level MEDIAN migration dates
# ============================================================

herd_migration_summary <- individual_migrations_std %>%
  group_by(migration_season) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),

    median_migration_start = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(migration_start_std),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    median_migration_end = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(migration_end_std),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    earliest_migration_start = min(
      migration_start_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    latest_migration_start = max(
      migration_start_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    earliest_migration_end = min(
      migration_end_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    latest_migration_end = max(
      migration_end_std,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      migration_season,
      levels = c("spring", "fall")
    )
  )

cat("\nHerd-level median migration date<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(herd_migration_summary, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 9) Put each deer's spring and fall dates on one row
# ============================================================

individual_season_dates <- individual_migrations_std %>%
  select(
    id,
    migration_season,
    migration_start_std,
    migration_end_std
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = migration_season,
    values_from = c(
      migration_start_std,
      migration_end_std
    ),
    names_glue = "{migration_season}_{.value}"
  )

# ============================================================
# 10) Calculate summer and winter duration for each deer
#
# Winter:
# fall migration end -> spring migration start
#
# Summer:
# spring migration end -> fall migration start
# ============================================================

individual_season_lengths <- individual_season_dates %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(spring_migration_start_std),
    !is.na(spring_migration_end_std),
    !is.na(fall_migration_start_std),
    !is.na(fall_migration_end_std)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    winter_start = fall_migration_end_std,
    winter_end   = spring_migration_start_std,

    summer_start = spring_migration_end_std,
    summer_end   = fall_migration_start_std,

    winter_start_day = yday(winter_start),
    winter_end_day   = yday(winter_end),

    summer_start_day = yday(summer_start),
    summer_end_day   = yday(summer_end),

    # Winter normally crosses December 31
    winter_days = if_else(
      winter_end_day >= winter_start_day,
      winter_end_day - winter_start_day,
      (366 - winter_start_day) + winter_end_day
    ),

    # Summer should normally occur within the same calendar year
    summer_days = if_else(
      summer_end_day >= summer_start_day,
      summer_end_day - summer_start_day,
      (366 - summer_start_day) + summer_end_day
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    id,
    winter_start,
    winter_end,
    winter_days,
    summer_start,
    summer_end,
    summer_days
  ) %>%
  arrange(id)

cat("\nIndividual deer season length<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(individual_season_lengths, n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 11) Herd-level MEDIAN season lengths
#
# The median duration is calculated from individual deer,
# rather than subtracting independently calculated herd dates.
# ============================================================

season_length_summary <- individual_season_lengths %>%
  summarise(
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),

    median_winter_start = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(winter_start),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    median_winter_end = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(winter_end),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    median_winter_days = median(
      winter_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_summer_start = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(summer_start),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    median_summer_end = as.Date(
      median(
        as.numeric(summer_end),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      origin = "1970-01-01"
    ),

    median_summer_days = median(
      summer_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

cat("\nMedian herd-level season summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(season_length_summary)

# ============================================================
# 12) Additional duration statistics for verification
# ============================================================

season_duration_statistics <- individual_season_lengths %>%
  summarise(
    n_ids = n_distinct(id),

    minimum_winter_days = min(
      winter_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    q25_winter_days = quantile(
      winter_days,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_winter_days = median(
      winter_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    q75_winter_days = quantile(
      winter_days,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    maximum_winter_days = max(
      winter_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    minimum_summer_days = min(
      summer_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    q25_summer_days = quantile(
      summer_days,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_summer_days = median(
      summer_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    q75_summer_days = quantile(
      summer_days,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    maximum_summer_days = max(
      summer_days,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

cat("\nSeason duration statistic<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(season_duration_statistics)
```

```{r}
cat("\nCoordinate columns detecte<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat("X coordinate:", x_col, "\n")
cat("Y coordinate:", y_col, "\n")

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    coord_x = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(.data[[x_col]])
    ),

    coord_y = suppressWarnings(

  filter(

# ============================================================
# 18) Helper functions
# ============================================================

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x)
}

safe_var <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  var(x)
}

safe_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sd(x)
}

safe_skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
      sd(x) == 0
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  e1071::skewness(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 2
  )
}

safe_kurtosis <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (
    length(x) < 4 ||
      sd(x) == 0
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  e1071::kurtosis(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 2
  )
}

wrap_angle <- function(x) {
  atan2(
    sin(x),
    cos(x)
  )
}

rolling_sinuosity_function <- function(x, y) {
  valid <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  x <- x[valid]
  y <- y[valid]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  net_displacement <- sqrt(
    (x[length(x)] - x[1])^2 +
      (y[length(y)] - y[1])^2
  )

  path_length <- sum(
    sqrt(
      diff(x)^2 +
        diff(y)^2
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (
    !is.finite(path_length) ||
      path_length <= 0
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  net_displacement / path_length
}

# ============================================================
# 19) Recalculate basic movement metrics
#
# Metrics are calculated separately for each ID and season.
# This prevents movement steps or rolling windows from crossing
# between winter and summer.
# ============================================================

all_data <- all_data %>%
  arrange(
    id,
    season,
    date_time
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    season
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Coordinate change between consecutive fixes
    dx = coord_x - lag(coord_x),
    dy = coord_y - lag(coord_y),

    # Time between consecutive fixes in seconds
    dt = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        date_time,
        lag(date_time),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    # Step distance
    dist = sqrt(
      dx^2 +
        dy^2
    ),

    # Remove invalid time intervals
    dt = if_else(
      is.na(dt) |
        dt <= 0,
      NA_real_,
      dt
    ),

    dist = if_else(
      is.na(dt),
      NA_real_,
      dist
    ),

    # Velocity
    velo = dist / dt,

    # Absolute bearing angle
    abs_angle = atan2(
      dy,
      dx
    ),

    # Relative turn angle
    rel_angle = wrap_angle(
      abs_angle -
        lag(abs_angle)
    ),

    # Absolute relative turn angle
    abs_rel_angle = abs(
      rel_angle
    ),

    # R2n:
    # squared displacement from the first point of each
    # ID-season trajectory
    r2n = (
      coord_x -
        first(coord_x)
    )^2 + (
      coord_y -
        first(coord_y)
    )^2,

    # Optional uppercase version for compatibility
    R2n = r2n
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# 20) Recalculate rolling 56-fix sinuosity
#
# Current observation plus previous 55 observations.
# ============================================================

all_data <- all_data %>%
  arrange(
    id,
    season,
    date_time
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    season
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sinuosity = slide2_dbl(
      coord_x,
      coord_y,
      .f = rolling_sinuosity_function,
      .before = 55,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# 21) Recalculate 56-fix rolling movement metrics
#
# Current observation plus previous 55 observations.
# ============================================================

all_data <- all_data %>%
  arrange(
    id,
    season,
    date_time
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    id,
    season
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Absolute relative turn angle
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rolling_abs_rel_angle_mean = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      safe_mean,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_abs_rel_angle_var = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      safe_var,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_abs_rel_angle_sd = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      safe_sd,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_abs_rel_angle_skew = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      safe_skewness,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_abs_rel_angle_kurt = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      safe_kurtosis,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Velocity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rolling_velo_mean = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      safe_mean,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_velo_var = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      safe_var,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_velo_sd = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      safe_sd,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_velo_skew = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      safe_skewness,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_velo_kurt = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      safe_kurtosis,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rolling_r2n_mean = slide_dbl(
      r2n,
      safe_mean,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_r2n_var = slide_dbl(
      r2n,

      .before = 55,

    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rolling_sinuosity_mean = slide_dbl(
      sinuosity,
      safe_mean,
      .before = 55,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    rolling_sinuosity_var = slide_dbl(
      sinuosity,

  ) %>%
```
